PART III - NARRATIVE
State below in reasonable detail the reasons why Forms 10-K, 20-F, 11-K, 10-Q,
N-SAR or the transition report or portion thereof could not be filed
within the prescribed time period.

Per Form 8-K filed on February 18, 2000, the Company is in the process of
restating its financial statements for 1997 and 1998. The financial
statements for 1999 and the audited financial statements cannot be finalized
until the 1998 10KSB/A is filed.
